configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: The OS presets are mutually exclusive through 'condition', so they all share build/x64-<cfg> as binaryDir while their preset names stay unique (<os>-<cfg>).

buildPresets.name: windows-debug
buildPresets.description: Maps each build preset 1:1 to the configure preset of the same name, so callers (CI, build.ps1, local builds) run 'cmake --build --preset <name>' instead of hardcoding 'cmake --build <binaryDir>'. Without this, binaryDir's naming convention would be duplicated in every caller instead of living only in configurePresets - the exact drift this file exists to prevent.

buildPresets.name: windows-release
buildPresets.description: See 'windows-debug' build preset for the rationale.
